customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

Before any firm classification: A grant decision posted in the stairwell has our manager's address but three project numbers; The rent attachment lists zero subsidies; The manager says the posting concerns several buildings; this order reflects what I know.

Regarding “conflicting evidence about allocating a renovation grant”, for an initial view: the grant project match remains unresolved; for the request “match the grant decision to the building and review gross, net, and allocated costs separately”: the information looks clear but leaves key questions open; on “conflicting evidence about allocating a renovation grant”, I feel stressed but will not rush; also unresolved: the net eligible costs; I need a professional view on that.

I am asking for: match the grant decision to the building and review gross, net, and allocated costs separately; in particular, I need clarity about the net eligible costs and which detail must be confirmed before classification.

Before proceeding; Please explain the grant project match; That will let me complete my records.

I first noticed this on 11 August 2025.

Ich kann bei Bedarf auch auf Deutsch antworten.

Best regards
